title: Ukraine: Oleshky ceasefire ends, Russian attacks continue
summary: A US-brokered ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region ended on Sunday night with no violations reported. But Russian drones and missiles hit other regions in Ukraine.
byline: Karl Sexton, Richard Connor, Darko Janjevic

image.caption: Russian drones were flying over Kyiv on SundayImage: Vladyslav Musiienko/AFP

blocks.text: Ukraine air force says public air raid alert app hacked
The Ukrainian Air Force said on Sunday evening that its public air raid alert app had been hacked.
For ​a short ​time, the app ‌showed the capital, Kyiv, and other areas subject to ‌a nuclear alert. But ​the abnormality later disappeared.
"The air alert ​app appears to have been ⁠subjected ​to enemy influence," ​the air force ​said on ‌Telegram. "There is no radiation threat! Stay ⁠calm and follow ⁠our ​updates on our channel!"
